row.title: Round-one fixes the early slices merged without are carried to main (RC, WD1)
row.body: Slices W01 to W09, PK and WI merged (#2530, #2544, #2575, #2576, #2581, #2583, #2585, #2586, #2588, #2593, #2594) before the round-one fixers changed 34 of their files, so main kept the pre-fix versions: claims trigger paging and gate, console-l3 health and drop items, deploy review, graph blast radius, fleet stagger, describe claims. RC carries them three ways onto main and WD1 adds the REST pull-request reader and the scan and review fixes; on the carried tree the core and packs suite ran 2043 tests with 0 failures and the workers Python suite passes. The comparison that finds such a file: every run-changed file's fixed version against main after each merge, not only the files of the slice being merged.
